summary: 1U all-NVMe PowerScale F710 node, described as leveraging a PowerEdge R660, for generative AI and other high-performance file workloads.

management.note: The F710 extract does not name the out-of-band manager. Do not assume iDRAC from the R660 base without that sentence in the F710 section.

processors.note: The node is described as leveraging PowerEdge R660. CPU SKUs were not in the F710 table and are not copied from a different server.

value.footnotes: 61 TB ISE requires OneFS 9.10 or later and SED requires OneFS 9.11 or later, per the sheet footnotes. 200/400 GbE options marked with footnote 4 require OneFS 9.14 for F710.

storage.note: The operating-system row in the HTML conversion of the F710 table was ambiguous and is not recorded as a OneFS version. SED and footnote requirements are recorded because those cells were explicit.

frontEnd: Dual-port 25 GbE NIC supporting 10 or 25 GbE
Dual-port 100 GbE NIC supporting 40 or 100 GbE
infrastructure: Dual-port 100 GbE NIC supporting 40 or 100 GbE
value.certification: Described as the first Ethernet-based storage appliance certified with NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD

value.planningBasis: Published maximum power consumption at 35C, 200-240 V, per node
value.note: The sheet says values below 25C reflect a more steady-state maximum during normal operation. 887 W is the planning default because it is the higher published maximum.

firmwareBaseline.reason: OneFS prerequisite notes are not a recommended firmware baseline. No OneFS build number was recorded.

referenceConfigurations.title: F710 all-NVMe node
referenceConfigurations.note: Drive capacity is selected from the published table. Cluster minimum is 3 nodes.
